modifications: sequence_num changed from 0 to 1, so it follows the frame it corrects.
events[0].type changed from "snapshot" to "update" — the other documented value — because a redelivery arrives as an update.
trades[0].price changed from "" to "1260.09": this is the SAME trade (same product_id and trade_id) carrying a usable price.
Everything else is unchanged from the fixture this is based on, which is the point: only the price differs.
